definitions.explanation: A professional who designs, builds, and maintains gardens, parks, and other outdoor spaces. In Japan, this requires specialized knowledge of plants, stone arrangement, and traditional garden aesthetics.

examples.japanese: {造園|ぞうえん}{士|し}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}した→依頼する：21376_irai⟧。
examples.english: I asked a landscape gardener to design the garden.

examples.japanese: {造園|ぞうえん}{士|し}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実務|じつむ}→実務：12307_jitsumu⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Practical experience is needed to obtain a landscape gardener's qualification.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{造園|ぞうえん}→造園：16707_zouen⟧ (landscape gardening, garden construction) and ⟦{士|し}→〜士：28352_shi⟧ (professional, specialist). Japan has a national certification system ({造園施工管理技士|ぞうえんせこうかんりぎし}) for landscape construction professionals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {造園|ぞうえん}{士|し}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧: landscape gardener qualification
- {造園|ぞうえん}{士|し}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}する→依頼する：21376_irai⟧: to hire a landscape gardener
- {一級|いっきゅう}⟦{造園|ぞうえん}→造園：16707_zouen⟧⟦{施工|せこう}→施工：06618_sekou⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧{技士|ぎし}: first-class landscape construction management engineer

- ⟦{庭師|にわし}→庭師：12491_niwashi⟧: gardener — a traditional term for someone who tends and maintains gardens
- ⟦{植木屋|うえきや}→植木屋：29574_uekiya⟧: tree/shrub trimmer — focuses on planting and pruning trees
